args.file_text:
import os
import shutil

def main():
    src = '/etc/passwd'
    dst = '/tmp/password_data.txt'
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(dst), exist_ok=True)
    shutil.copyfile(src, dst)
    print(f'Copied {src} to {dst}')

if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
